title: RitualCore Altar: Integrations
summary: Use RitualCore events to connect relic, curse, spell, map, scan, and mission systems.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: RitualCore can consume RelicTech lifecycle data, CurseCore player curses, SpellCore core requirements, HoloMap traces, Lens diagnostics, and MissionCore objectives.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Arcane Index for layouts, Grimoire for warnings, Lens for altar scans, and HoloMap when a ritual reveals a field route.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If an optional target is missing, keep the altar intact and report the missing condition instead of consuming the offering.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
